description: The dominant colours of a JPEG, PNG or WebP (3–12), sorted by share, as HEX, RGB and HSL, with CSS variables and the pairs that pass WCAG AA. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

colors.description: How many dominant colours to return (3–12). A picture with fewer distinct colours returns fewer, and says so in fewer.

data.description: The image file as base64, in the format given by type.

name.description: The source filename. Used only to name the palette strip, as <stem>-palette.png.

strip.description: Also return the palette as a PNG strip of equal blocks (base64 in strip.data).

type.description: The MIME type of the image: image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp.

name: color_palette_from_image
title: Color Palette from Image
